topic: What would happen if the Earth was twice its size?

scenario.clickbait_title: EARTH DOUBLES IN SIZE... YOU HAVE MINUTES.
scenario.seo_description: What if Earth suddenly doubled its size? Experience the terrifying, scientifically accurate consequences in this viral short. Double gravity, crushing pressure, and a world torn apart. Can humanity survive?
scenario.title: What If Earth Was TWICE Its Size?
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A terrified person looking up at a dramatically larger Earth looming in the sky, with cracks appearing on the ground beneath them. Strong vertical composition, high contrast, cinematic lighting.

scenes.narration: CRUSHED. Your bones shatter instantly. Everything you know collapses. You weigh double, your body screaming. Even standing is impossible. The air itself feels like lead. Can you breathe?
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL 9:16. A photorealistic, hyper-detailed shot of a person's hand straining against the ground, fingers splayed, cracking pavement visible beneath. Their body is visibly compressed, struggling against an invisible, immense downward force. Buildings in the background are buckling and collapsing. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, pushing in slightly on the hand.
scenes.twist_element: The physical crushing and the inability to breathe, leaving the viewer wondering if this is the only threat.

scenes.narration: But Roli witnessed the true horror. Your own blood becomes too heavy. Your heart, battling double gravity, fails in minutes. Organs collapse. You have 30 minutes. What happens to the world itself?
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL 9:16. Roli, a photorealistic anthropomorphic rabbit scientist in a worn brass-and-leather steampunk spacesuit with goggles on his forehead, amber eyes, stands against a swirling, dark, storm-filled sky. He holds a glowing blue pocket-watch, looking directly at the camera with a grim, knowing expression. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, slow zoom out from Roli.
scenes.twist_element: The unexpected internal failure of the body and the cliffhanger about the planet's fate.

scenes.narration: The doubled mass means immense core pressure. Volcanic eruptions rip the surface. The sky, thick with compressed air, traps heat. Tidal forces tear continents apart. Soon, only molten rock remains. CRUSHED.
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL 9:16. An extreme wide shot of a massively scaled-up Earth's surface, fractured and erupting with molten lava. Dark, heavy clouds of ash and steam obscure the sky. The camera slowly pans across a landscape of continuous, violent volcanic activity, showing continents visibly pulling apart. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, apocalyptic scale.
